opener_concept: Flip two coins: chance of two tails is 1 in 4. Counting HH/HT/TH/TT by common sense IS a Punnett square; each Tt parent is a coin (half T, half t), so Tt x Tt gives tt 1 time in 4 = 25%.

notes: Genetics-probability lesson, so the science 'walk ritual' was adapted: identify gametes -> fill the 4-cell Punnett square -> count matching cells -> convert fraction to decimal/percentage (the explicit conversion box, analogous to unit conversion) -> scale to population where asked -> final say/done states the answer with its form (0.75, 25%, 40 offspring). No unit typed in boxes.
